note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We are buying a regional HVAC services company. The seller reports adjusted EBITDA of $5.2 million, and the price being discussed is 8x EBITDA.

answers.common.decision: What EBITDA to price the deal on; the deal lead decides.
answers.common.audience: The deal lead and the investment committee.
answers.common.materials: Last year's EBITDA includes a one-off insurance gain of $250,000. A maintenance contract that contributed $400,000 of EBITDA ended last year. The owner takes no salary; replacing him needs a general manager at $200,000 a year.
answers.finance-modeling.purpose: Test the seller's adjusted EBITDA and show its effect on price.
answers.finance-modeling.data: The seller's adjusted EBITDA bridge and last year's accounts, in US dollars.
